warnings: House title block: 'บ้านสกาวรัตน์', 'SMILE HOME' TYPE M, V.1 [11/2/45], donated design from บริษัท แลนดี้ โฮม (ประเทศไทย) จำกัด, under the same 'แบบบ้านยิ้มเพื่อประชาชน' program as houses 09/14/16/18/19/20/28 but a contributed design, not the ธรรมรักษา series — noticeably lower scan quality (visible handwritten annotations, uneven contrast) than the other houses in this batch. This document has NO index/TOC page and NO 'S-xx' sheet-code system at all — pages are identified purely by their drawn title ('ผังโครงสร้างฐานราก', 'ผังโครงสร้างชั้นล่าง', etc.), so sheet_code is null throughout this house's files.

Building footprint is irregular (an L-shape / notched rectangle, not a simple box) — grid columns 2-5 and rows A-E are the FULL bounding grid, but not every grid point is inside the building (e.g. no footing at A1/B1/E1, per the footing plan). Did not force a rectangular reading.

A secondary sub-dimension chain on the floor-beam plans (0.50/3.60/0.90/0.50/0.50 along x, various small clusters along y) locates interior beam lines (B1'/B3'/C2) more precisely than the main grid — did not fully re-derive exact pos_m for these interior points from that chain given time constraints on this house; C2's x-position is approximated at grid 4 (see plan_beam files) rather than a separately resolved dummy line. Flagged as a known gap, not silently resolved.

Beam-top levels vary per beam (printed directly on each beam mark as e.g. 'B6(+0.35)', 'B1(+3.65)') rather than a single project-wide floor level — this is real per-beam data, not a transcription artefact, and is recorded on each beam element's own 'level_m' below.
